root_idea.summary: The root has two principal orientations: seeking or making for something, and a separate reproductive vocabulary concerning impregnation and delayed birth.
root_idea.development: The seeking-and-aiming branch develops into going forth against an enemy and the related vocabulary of war expeditions, combatants, and campaigns. A distinct branch concerns difficult impregnation and late parturition in female animals.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized singular active-participle citation form غَازٍ; the Quran occurrence is its plural form غُزًّى.

senses.definition: One who goes forth to fight an enemy; a combatant or raider.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic form is the plural غُزًّى, referring to people engaged in going out for combat.

senses.definition: A company or body of combatants on a warlike expedition.
senses.usage_conditions: A collective or quasi-plural use of غُزًّى, the form occurring in the Quran.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To will, desire, seek, aim at, intend, or mean something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used with an object or with reference to the intended meaning of speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go forth, repair, or betake oneself to fight the enemy, sometimes with the aim of plundering them, in their country.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object may be understood when the verb is used alone in this sense.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To go or turn toward someone or something; to make for or seek it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A construction with إِلَى expressing directed movement or purpose.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Excellence or commendable quality in engaging in a warlike expedition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized abstract noun associated with warring or warring and plundering expeditions.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To equip, send, urge, or incite someone to engage in a warlike expedition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is the person being fitted out, sent, or encouraged for the expedition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman whose husband is absent on a war expedition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional use referring to the husband's departure to fight the enemy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a female animal: to have difficult impregnation, or to be difficult to impregnate.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested particularly of a she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To grant someone a delay by deferring the collection of a debt owed by him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A causative or transitive use concerning postponement of payment.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To single someone out and take him as one's own from among his companions; figuratively, to have a charge or cause peculiarly assigned to something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The construction بِـ marks the person or matter singled out or assigned.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A warlike expedition or campaign: the act of going out to fight, and sometimes plunder, the enemy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: It may denote a single expedition or, in one usage, the operations of a campaign or year's work.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A mode or manner of seeking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct vocalized form with the meaning of طِلْبَةٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The cat, regarded as one that continually makes war upon mice.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An epithet or nickname based on the cat's habitual pursuit of mice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of or relating to warfare or a warlike expedition.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A relational adjective; variant vocalizations are reported in the lexical tradition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One who engages frequently or extensively in warfare or warlike expeditions.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intensive description of habitual participation in غَزْو.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The offspring of camels from the summer season, regarded as undesirable because the young are weak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral term concerning seasonal camel offspring.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The intended sense or meaning of a saying.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used for the purport or intended meaning of speech.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A female animal that is late in giving birth after delayed conception or prolonged pregnancy.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Reported of a she-camel, a she-ass, and sheep or goats that give birth later than the others.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place to which a warlike expedition is made or where warfare occurs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Its plural is مَغَازٍ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The memorable deeds or exploits of warriors and raiders.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural term, especially for the notable campaigns or deeds of those who engage in غَزْو.

other_classical_meanings.definition: One subjected to a raid or attack; a person used as the object of غَزَا.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as an epithet for a man; مَغْزُوٌّ is the regular passive-participial form.

cautions: The sole Quran occurrence is the plural form غُزًّى; the public headword is normalized to the supported singular active participle غَازٍ. The contextual gloss “fighting” is supported here by the lexical explanations of going forth to combat the enemy.
